mus_title.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Wide, hopeful space colony theme. Slow evolving synth pads and soft solo piano, distant planet horizon, gentle sense of wonder and new beginnings. 70 BPM. Calm build, soft ending that can loop.

mus_day_1.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Calm ambient electronic music for building a colony on a warm desert planet. Warm analog pads, light plucked synth pulse, soft percussion, curious and optimistic. 85 BPM. Steady, unobtrusive background music for a strategy game.

mus_day_2.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Relaxed ambient electronic, sunny alien planet, gentle marimba and synth arpeggio, warm bass, airy pads, productive and curious mood. 90 BPM. Unobtrusive background music for a colony strategy game.

mus_night.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Sparse, cool night ambience on a quiet alien planet. Low soft drones, gentle distant bells, slow airy pads, calm and a little lonely, peaceful. 60 BPM. Very unobtrusive background music.

mus_tension.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Tense sci-fi emergency underscore for a colony under threat. Low pulsing bass, rising string and synth ostinato, ticking percussion, urgent but not horror, steady intensity. 100 BPM. Loopable game background music.

mus_arrival.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Short bright cinematic cue for a spaceship arriving at a colony. Warm brass and synth swell, hopeful rising chord, gentle resolve at the end. 25 seconds.
